datasets.name: kpi_today
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_requests,
  ROUND(AVG(execution_duration_ms), 0) AS avg_latency_ms,
  ROUND(percentile(execution_duration_ms, 0.95), 0) AS p95_latency_ms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errores,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS error_rate_pct,
  COUNT(DISTINCT requester) AS unique_users
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.agente_inference_payload
WHERE request_date >= current_date()

datasets.name: kpi_gold
queryLines:
SELECT
  SUM(total_runs) AS total_runs,
  SUM(runs_exitosos) AS runs_exitosos,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(runs_exitosos) / NULLIF(SUM(total_runs), 0), 2) AS pct_exitosos,
  ROUND(AVG(latencia_p95_ms), 0) AS avg_p95,
  ROUND(SUM(costo_usd), 4) AS costo_usd_total,
  ROUND(AVG(feedback_score_avg), 3) AS feedback_avg
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.metricas_agente_gold

datasets.name: latency_trend
queryLines:
SELECT
  hora,
  model,
  latencia_promedio_ms,
  latencia_p95_ms,
  total_runs
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.metricas_agente_gold
ORDER BY hora

datasets.name: volume_by_hour
queryLines:
SELECT
  hora,
  SUM(total_runs) AS total_runs,
  SUM(runs_exitosos) AS exitosos,
  SUM(total_runs - runs_exitosos) AS errores
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.metricas_agente_gold
GROUP BY hora
ORDER BY hora

datasets.name: intents_top
queryLines:
SELECT
  intent,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  ROUND(AVG(latency_ms), 0) AS latencia_avg,
  SUM(CASE WHEN success THEN 0 ELSE 1 END) AS errores
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.eventos_agente_silver
GROUP BY intent
ORDER BY total DESC

datasets.name: feedback_trend
queryLines:
SELECT
  date(timestamp) AS dia,
  SUM(CASE WHEN user_feedback='thumbs_up' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positivos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN user_feedback='thumbs_down' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS negativos,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.eventos_agente_silver
GROUP BY dia
ORDER BY dia

datasets.name: tokens_by_model
queryLines:
SELECT
  model,
  SUM(tokens_input) AS tokens_in,
  SUM(tokens_output) AS tokens_out,
  ROUND(SUM(costo_usd_aprox), 4) AS costo_aprox
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.eventos_agente_silver
GROUP BY model

datasets.name: inference_recent
queryLines:
SELECT
  request_time,
  status_code,
  execution_duration_ms,
  requester,
  substring(request, 1, 80) AS request_preview,
  substring(response, 1, 80) AS response_preview
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.agente_inference_payload
ORDER BY request_time DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: cost_by_sku_7d
queryLines:
SELECT
  date(usage_start_time) AS dia,
  sku_name,
  ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity), 2) AS dbus
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE usage_start_time >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
GROUP BY dia, sku_name
ORDER BY dia, sku_name

datasets.name: cost_total_7d
queryLines:
SELECT
  ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity), 2) AS dbus_total_7d,
  ROUND(SUM(usage_quantity) / 7, 2) AS dbus_diarios_avg,
  COUNT(DISTINCT sku_name) AS skus_usados
FROM system.billing.usage
WHERE usage_start_time >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS

datasets.name: audit_recent
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_time,
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  service_name,
  action_name,
  response.status_code AS status
FROM system.access.audit
WHERE event_date = current_date()
  AND user_identity.email = current_user()
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: lineage
queryLines:
SELECT
  source_table_full_name AS source,
  target_table_full_name AS target,
  source_type,
  MAX(event_time) AS last_access
FROM system.access.table_lineage
WHERE source_table_full_name LIKE 'ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.%'
   OR target_table_full_name LIKE 'ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.%'
GROUP BY source, target, source_type
ORDER BY last_access DESC
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: drift_metrics
queryLines:
SELECT
  window.start AS hora,
  slice_value AS modelo,
  column_name,
  ROUND(js_distance, 4) AS js_distance,
  ROUND(wasserstein_distance, 4) AS wasserstein,
  ROUND(population_stability_index, 4) AS psi,
  ROUND(avg_delta, 4) AS avg_delta,
  drift_type
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.metricas_agente_gold_drift_metrics
WHERE column_name IN ('latencia_promedio_ms','latencia_p95_ms','feedback_score_avg','costo_usd','total_runs')
ORDER BY hora DESC
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: vs_health
queryLines:
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_docs,
  COUNT(DISTINCT categoria) AS categorias,
  SUM(longitud_chars) AS chars_totales,
  ROUND(AVG(longitud_chars), 0) AS chars_avg
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.documentos_subsidios

datasets.name: tables_in_schema
queryLines:
SELECT
  table_name,
  table_type,
  table_owner,
  created,
  comment
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.information_schema.tables
WHERE table_schema = 'comfama'
ORDER BY created DESC

datasets.name: column_tags
queryLines:
SELECT
  table_name,
  column_name,
  tag_name,
  tag_value
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.information_schema.column_tags
WHERE schema_name = 'comfama'
ORDER BY table_name, column_name

datasets.name: permissions
queryLines:
SELECT
  privilege_type,
  grantor,
  grantee,
  inherited_from
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.information_schema.table_privileges
WHERE table_schema = 'comfama'
LIMIT 50

datasets.name: quality_summary
queryLines:
SELECT
  model,
  COUNT(*) AS ventanas,
  ROUND(AVG(latencia_promedio_ms), 0) AS lat_avg_ms,
  ROUND(percentile(latencia_p95_ms, 0.95), 0) AS lat_p95_max,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(runs_exitosos) / NULLIF(SUM(total_runs), 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct,
  ROUND(AVG(feedback_score_avg), 3) AS feedback_avg,
  ROUND(SUM(costo_usd), 4) AS costo_usd
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.metricas_agente_gold
GROUP BY model

datasets.name: quality_trend_latency
datasets.displayName: Latencia y P95 en el tiempo
queryLines:
SELECT
  hora,
  model,
  latencia_promedio_ms,
  latencia_p95_ms
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.metricas_agente_gold
ORDER BY hora

datasets.name: quality_trend_success
queryLines:
SELECT
  hora,
  model,
  ROUND(100.0 * runs_exitosos / NULLIF(total_runs, 0), 2) AS success_rate_pct,
  feedback_score_avg
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.metricas_agente_gold
ORDER BY hora

datasets.name: feedback_breakdown
queryLines:
SELECT
  user_feedback,
  COUNT(*) AS total
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.eventos_agente_silver
WHERE user_feedback IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY user_feedback

datasets.name: audit_all_schema
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_time,
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  service_name,
  action_name,
  CASE WHEN response.status_code BETWEEN 200 AND 299 THEN '✅ ok'
       WHEN response.status_code >= 400 THEN '❌ error'
       ELSE CAST(response.status_code AS STRING) END AS resultado,
  request_params.full_name_arg AS objeto
FROM system.access.audit
WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND (
    request_params.full_name_arg LIKE 'ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.%'
    OR request_params.target_full_name LIKE 'ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.%'
    OR request_params.commandText LIKE '%comfama.%'
  )
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 100

datasets.name: audit_by_user
queryLines:
SELECT
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  COUNT(*) AS acciones,
  COUNT(DISTINCT action_name) AS tipos_distintos,
  MAX(event_time) AS ultima_actividad
FROM system.access.audit
WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND request_params.full_name_arg LIKE 'ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.%'
GROUP BY user_email
ORDER BY acciones DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: audit_failed
queryLines:
SELECT
  event_time,
  user_identity.email AS user_email,
  action_name,
  response.status_code AS status,
  response.error_message AS error,
  request_params.full_name_arg AS objeto
FROM system.access.audit
WHERE event_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
  AND response.status_code >= 400
  AND (request_params.full_name_arg LIKE 'ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.%' OR request_params.commandText LIKE '%comfama.%')
ORDER BY event_time DESC
LIMIT 30

datasets.name: endpoint_invocations
queryLines:
SELECT
  date_trunc('hour', request_time) AS hora,
  COUNT(*) AS invocaciones,
  COUNT(DISTINCT requester) AS usuarios_unicos,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errores,
  ROUND(AVG(execution_duration_ms), 0) AS lat_avg
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.agente_inference_payload
WHERE request_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
GROUP BY hora
ORDER BY hora

datasets.name: endpoint_users
queryLines:
SELECT
  requester AS usuario,
  COUNT(*) AS invocaciones,
  ROUND(AVG(execution_duration_ms), 0) AS lat_avg_ms,
  SUM(CASE WHEN status_code >= 400 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errores,
  MIN(request_time) AS primer_uso,
  MAX(request_time) AS ultimo_uso
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.agente_inference_payload
WHERE request_date >= current_date() - INTERVAL 7 DAYS
GROUP BY requester
ORDER BY invocaciones DESC

datasets.name: sql_alerts_status
queryLines:
SELECT
  display_name AS nombre,
  query_text AS query,
  created_by,
  created_at,
  last_modified_at
FROM system.lakeflow.sql_queries
WHERE display_name LIKE '%comfama%'
   OR query_text LIKE '%comfama%'
ORDER BY last_modified_at DESC
LIMIT 20

datasets.name: alert_query_results
datasets.displayName: Resultado actual de la alert query
queryLines:
SELECT
  model,
  ROUND(percentile(latency_ms, 0.95), 0) AS p95_latency_ms,
  COUNT(*) AS total_runs,
  SUM(CASE WHEN NOT success THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errores
FROM ardemo_classic_dnubtw_catalog.comfama.eventos_agente_silver
WHERE timestamp >= current_timestamp() - INTERVAL 1 HOUR
GROUP BY model
